I'm Tan Yi Jie. I write data deep dives on Singapore's public transport: which bus routes are most crowded, which MRT stations and line segments are busiest, and what the patterns say about how the city moves.

## Data

Most analyses use open data from [LTA DataMall](https://datamall.lta.gov.sg/) (passenger volume by origin and destination, bus routes, train stations), plus route shapes from [BusRouter SG](https://busrouter.sg/) and map boundaries from [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg/). Each post explains its method and assumptions. All figures are estimates derived from that data, not official LTA statistics.

## Elsewhere

Earlier versions of these articles were first published on [Medium](https://medium.com/@simpletan). This site is now their main home.

Found a mistake or have an idea for the next analysis? Leave a comment under any post.

## About this site {#about-this-site}

This site is built and run with *mostly* free, open-source tools:

- **Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)**, an open-source publishing system for data writing, and **hosted on [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/)**.
- **Likes and comments** use [giscus](https://giscus.app/). You need a GitHub account to like or comment.
- **Subscriptions and email updates** are sent with [Buttondown](https://buttondown.com/).
- **Visitor statistics** come from [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com/)
- **The interactive map** uses [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) with base maps from [OneMap](https://www.onemap.gov.sg/) by the Singapore Land Authority.
- **Data** comes from [LTA DataMall](https://datamall.lta.gov.sg/), [BusRouter SG](https://busrouter.sg/) and [data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg/), as credited in each post.
- **The website itself** (its design, code and setup) was built with the help of [Claude](https://claude.ai). Claude also helped move the articles over from Medium, doing mainly tasks like typing out tables that were previously images, fixing typos, and writing the TL;DRs and page descriptions. The analysis, data and writing are my own.

The site's source is public at [github.com/yijietan/yijietan.github.io](https://github.com/yijietan/yijietan.github.io).
